import HexECPP
open Hex.ECPP

def certificate : Cert := .base (.small 17)
#guard checkAt 17 certificate
#guard !checkAt 19 certificate
#guard (produce 17 0).result.toOption.any (checkAt 17)
#guard (convertText defaultImportBudget "17" (.small 17)).isOk
#guard match (produce 17 0 { maxBits := 4 }).result with
  | .error e => e.resource == .inputBits
  | _ => false

-- Directly exercise the native GMP branch and the exported Lean fallback.
#guard Nat.extendedGcd 0 0 = ⟨0, 0, 1⟩
#guard Nat.extendedGcd (2 ^ 128) (2 ^ 128) = ⟨2 ^ 128, 1, 0⟩
#guard Nat.extendedGcd (2 ^ 128) (2 ^ 128 + 1) =
  Nat.extendedGcd.go (2 ^ 128) 1 0 (2 ^ 128 + 1) 0 1
#guard HexArith.Int.extGcd 0 0 = (0, 1, 0)
#guard HexArith.Int.extGcd (-6) 4 = (2, 1, 2)
#guard HexArith.Int.extGcd (2 ^ 128) (2 ^ 128 + 1) =
  Hex.pureIntExtGcd (2 ^ 128) (2 ^ 128 + 1)
